title: 第15章 坏了真出大事了第16章 冷月涵拿捏
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
“我的天！冷……冷师姐她在干什么？！”
“那动作……怎么跟旁边那几只大猩猩一模一样？！”
“我没看错吧？她这是被金刚反过来操控了？！”
这一刻，无数弟子，全都傻眼了。
看着擂台上原本高不可攀的大师姐，此刻却双目赤红，四肢着地，以一种充满了原始力量感的姿势，凶悍地扑向秦无涯。
那迅猛的速度，那狂野的气势，那微微弓起的背脊，那每一次发力时肌肉的贲张……
活脱脱就是一只母猩猩！
“完了完了，我心中冰清玉洁的大师姐形象彻底回不来了！”
“这……这冲击力也太强了，不行了，我感觉我的道心都快不稳了！”
“竟然被大猩猩反过来操纵，金刚丹以后，恐怕不能买了啊！”
无数男弟子捂住了胸口，感觉自己多年来建立起来的对大师姐的美好幻想，在这一刻被无情地践踏得粉碎。
“啊？你们没觉得，这样的大师姐，别有一番魅力吗？”
“我们体修，就该这样啊！”
唰唰唰！
数道目光，同时聚集在了说话的弟子身上。
他还在侃侃而谈：“当然，依我看，还是大师姐召唤出来的那个母猩猩更胜一筹，你看那肌肉、那力量……啧啧，体修的榜样啊！”
李玄一脸的生无可恋。
完了，彻底完了。
自己的丹药，恐怕卖不出去了。
早就让冷月涵试药，冷月涵不试就算了，还一次吃一大把！

这……
他现在只想找个地缝钻进去。
擂台之上，面对如同野兽般扑来的冷月涵，秦无涯那温文尔雅的表情早已消失不见，取而代之的是前所未有的凝重。
他深知冷月涵体修的强大，此刻见她气势更胜从前，丝毫不敢怠慢。
“玄冰盾！”
秦无涯临危不乱，单手掐诀，身前瞬间凝结出一面晶莹剔透的冰盾，寒气四溢。
“嘭！”
冷月涵的拳头，裹挟着千钧之力，狠狠地砸在了冰盾之上！
冰屑四溅！
那厚实的冰盾，竟在这一拳之下，被瞬间打爆！
秦无涯瞳孔猛地一缩。
content_en:
"Oh my God! Leng...Senior Sister Leng, what is she doing?!"
"How come that action...is exactly the same as the gorillas next to it?!"
"Did I read that correctly? Is she being manipulated by King Kong?!"
At this moment, countless disciples were all dumbfounded.
Looking at the originally unattainable Senior Sister on the stage, now her eyes were red, she was on all fours, and she fiercely pounced on Qin Wuya in a posture full of raw power.
That rapid speed, that wild momentum, that slightly arched back, the tension of the muscles every time you exert force...
She looks exactly like a female orangutan!
"It's over, it's over. The image of the pure and pure Senior Sister in my heart will never come back!"
"This...the impact is too strong, it won't work anymore, I feel like my Taoist heart is almost unstable!"
"It's actually being manipulated by a gorilla. I'm afraid I won't be able to buy the Vajra Pill from now on!"
Countless male disciples covered their chests, feeling that the beautiful illusions they had built up over the years about their senior sister were ruthlessly trampled to pieces at this moment.
"Ah? Don't you think that such a senior sister is so charming?"
"This is how we should cultivate our bodies!"
Swish, swish, swish!
Several eyes were focused on the disciple who spoke.
He was still talking: "Of course, in my opinion, the female orangutan summoned by the senior sister is better. Look at the muscles and the strength... tsk tsk, what a role model for physical training!"
Li Xuan looked helpless.
It's over, completely over.
I'm afraid I won't be able to sell my elixir.
Leng Yuehan had been asked to test the medicine a long time ago. If Leng Yuehan didn’t try it, he would just take a big handful at a time!
This...
Now he just wants to find a crack in the ground and crawl into it.
On the stage, facing Leng Yuehan who was charging at him like a wild beast, Qin Wuya's gentle and elegant expression had long since disappeared, replaced by an unprecedented dignity.
He knew very well how powerful Leng Yuehan's physical cultivation was, and seeing that her momentum was even stronger than before, he did not dare to neglect her at all.
"Black Ice Shield!"
Qin Wuya remained calm in the face of danger, and made a seal with one hand. A crystal clear ice shield instantly formed in front of him, and the cold air filled the air.
"Bang!"
Leng Yuehan's fist, packed with tremendous force, hit the ice shield hard!
Ice chips are flying!
The thick ice shield was instantly exploded by this punch!
Qin Wuya's pupils shrank suddenly.
